messages:
sara: @support Hey — customer (acct: acme-inc) reports streaming completions cut off ~30s after start. They get partial tokens, client reconnects then continues but duplicates & billing doubled. Request id rreq-5567. ALB in front (us-east-1) + nginx ingress. Any ideas?

tony: Can you paste the full request id and the last 10 lines from the app proxy logs? Also are they using SSE or chunked streaming?

sara: It's SSE (text/event-stream). App logs show we sent final chunk but client saw EOF. In our ingress logs we see upstream 200 then ALB returned 502 after 30s with message "Idle connection timeout". app request id rreq-5567. Snippet:

support-bot: Created ticket INF-9421 for rreq-5567 — link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-9421 :ticket:

nate: Quick hypothesis: ALB idle timeout defaults to 60s but clients or CDN (Cloudflare) or nginx might be buffering. If ALB sees no TCP activity for its idle window it will close. Are we sending keepalive chunks or heartbeat whitespace? Also check nginx proxy_buffering is on by default — that will wait for buffer fill before flushing.

devex-ryan: Repro steps I just ran:
```
# reproduce from my laptop
curl -v -N "https://api.staging.redwood.com/v1/stream?model=gpt-test" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST" \
  --no-buffer --max-time 120
```
I saw initial tokens then silence ~28s then "curl: (18) transfer closed with outstanding read data".

sara: nginx ingress config we use (current):
```
proxy_http_version 1.1;
proxy_set_header Connection "";
proxy_buffering on;
proxy_buffers 8 16k;
proxy_busy_buffers_size 32k;
# missing X-Accel-Buffering header
```

tony: Try setting proxy_buffering off and add `proxy_set_header X-Accel-Buffering "no";` and ensure `proxy_http_version 1.1` + `chunked_transfer_encoding off` depending. Also ALB needs idle timeout > expected silence. Can you check ALB idle timeout? Default is 60s but some customers set 30s

sara: ALB idle timeout set to 30s in customer's infra (ouch). Cloudflare in front with "Standard" proxy mode (which does buffering). So multiple layers could buffer & close.

nate: Proposed mitigations:
- short term: change ALB idle timeout to 120 (or 300) and set nginx proxy_buffering off
- better: emit heartbeat chunk (":\n") every 10s from app during stalls
- long term: recommend NLB passthrough + Cloudflare Spectrum/TCP or bypass buffering proxies

devex-ryan: For reproducing reliably, capture tcpdump on host and ALB logs. Example tcpdump filter:
```
sudo tcpdump -i eth0 host <client-ip> and port 443 -w dump.pcap
```
Also capture app traces (request id header x-request-id: rreq-5567).

sara: I already captured nginx access log for rreq-5567 and attached to ticket: upstream_response_time=0.45, request_time=31.2, alb_status=502, client_reconnect_count=2

tony: One more gotcha — some intermediary proxies will coalesce small writes then flush only when buffer full or after a timeout. That causes 'early silence' despite the app pushing events. So both kernel TCP keepalive and application heartbeats are useful.

sara: Customer asked about billing spike — disconnects/ reconnects caused additional token charging because each reconnect completed a new request stream. We're working with billing to reconcile. I'll add note to INF-9421.

nate: I'll try the proxy config change in staging and run the devex-ryan curl repro. If performance holds we'll roll to production with ALB idle timeout bump and heartbeat patch.

sara: Thanks — assigning next actions in ticket. :thumbsup:
